entries.title: Merging a pull request a task did not open waits for GitHub
entries.body: Just after new work reaches your main branch, GitHub can take a few seconds to work out whether a pull request can still merge. When a task asked you to merge a pull request it did not open, such as another task's, a click in that moment was refused. The app now asks GitHub again for up to half a minute and merges at the version you approved as soon as GitHub says it can. If GitHub still has not decided, nothing merges and the task hears why.
entries.noPicture: The card looks the same; the click now merges where it used to be refused.
